title: The second note
venue: the coast community-college paper, Newport · the laundromat digest
source: lore/drift_wood/_THE_COMPLETE_RUN.md (1999–2000 · deepening xix · the daily filled)
logline: A second note in the rack, the careful old hand: 'The uncle. Draw him while you can.' Wood reads it at the rack and puts it in his pocket without folding it. He doesn't draw the uncle that week. He draws him the week after, every day.

panels.composition: The rack. A folded note in the digest's slot. The careful hand.

panels.composition: Wood walking out with the note in his hand, not folded, not pocketed. The LAUNDRY owner watching him go. She knows the hand too. The strip doesn't say whose.
